Name: Adomin8er's HD Vanilla Portraits and Genderbend
Author: Adomin8er
Description:
[size=4]DISCORD:[/size]
Adomin8er's Modding Server → [url=https://discord.gg/vmfHg2HkNn]sdv-hd-portraits-and-genderbend[/url][size=4]

Mod Purpose:[/size]
Adds in HD Portraits of all the VANILLA Stardew Valley characters as well as allows for genderbending of bachelors and bachelorettes.
New portraits for:
[list]
[*]Base[/*]
[*]Raining[/*]
[*]Winter[/*]
[*]Winter Rain[/*]
[*]Winter Snow[/*]
[*]Spirits Eve[/*]
[*]Beach[/*]
[*]And more[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]Compatible Mods:[/size]
[list]
[*]Who knows? It might get taken down.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4]﻿Recommendation:[/size]
Play because you like the game.
